Hi Sara / Matt —

Thanks for joining the MAP checkpoint last week. Per our agreement, this thread will serve as the weekly action ledger for the Acme Health pilot so both teams have a single source of truth for: status against the evaluation plan, acceptance gate progress, and any blockers that will affect close timing.

Quick summary + attachments:
- Attached: MAP_v1.3.pdf (mutual action plan with owners) and eval_plan_acme.xlsx (detailed test cases + data slices).
- Overall status: "On track with outstanding infra blocker" (see blockers section).

Key acceptance gates (short):
1) Latency SLA: 95th percentile <= 220ms for 1k QPS synthetic workload (baseline tests).
2) Quality: pass rate >= 92% on the 120-case evaluation prompt set (see eval sheet).
3) Security: SOC2 evidence upload and network allowlist configured.
4) Integration: sample inference pipeline connected to Acme sandbox with tokenized logs delivered to your audit S3.

Meeting notes / progress:
- Marcus completed baseline quantized runs; results attached in eval sheet (tab: baseline_runs).
- Neha completed checklist for SOC2 evidence; we still need the completed vendor form from your procurement team.

Open blockers (owners):
- Vendor form from Acme procurement (owner: Acme) — prevents final security sign-off.
- Network egress IPs not approved in sandbox (owner: Acme IT) — Marcus has a temporary NAT workaround but needs permanent allowlist entries.
- Minor model mismatch on specialty prompt set (owner: Marcus) — suggested tweak: enable prefix caching for the 2 prompts that show regression.

Actions (owners & due dates):
- Sara: share procurement vendor form by 2026-11-05.
- Marcus: produce patched eval run and notes by 2026-11-06.
- Neha: upload remaining SOC2 evidence artifacts to shared drive by 2026-11-04.
- Hannah: coordinate a final gate call week of Nov 9 if the above are closed.

Please reply with any adjustments; will follow up mid-week if we don't hear back on the procurement item.

Thanks,
Hannah

Sara / team —

Update from infra / eval: I ran the patched quantized model across the 120-case set. Highlights:
- Quality: overall pass rate improved from 89% -> 93% after prefix-caching change (details in eval_plan_acme.xlsx, tab: patched_runs).
- Latency: median is ~140ms, p95 on the synthetic 1k QPS harness currently 230ms — so we are ~10ms over target.
- Root cause for p95: a sub-path that triggers an atypical attention pattern for 5% of requests; I have a plan to mitigate with a specialized kernel selection but it needs an infra deploy.

Blocker detail:
- Allowlist: the permanent NAT entry is mandatory for the kernel deploy; temporary NAT we used for baseline is not permitted by Acme's sandbox for production-like runs.
- Timeline: kernel deploy needs a maintenance window (approx 2 hours) and infra approval. If allowlist is in place by 2026-11-09, I can schedule the deploy for 2026-11-10 and deliver final numbers by 2026-11-11.

Action updates:
- Marcus: prepare kernel deploy plan + rollback by 2026-11-08 (done, plan attached to eval sheet).
- Neha: once Sara confirms procurement, I'll mark security gate as ready.
